# J. Fortitude Legacy Institute

> A Kansas City–based 501(c)(3) (pending) nonprofit building lasting community capacity through hands-on education, applied innovation, holistic wellness, and a future land-based campus.

The J. Fortitude Legacy Institute (JFLI) operates programs in adult holistic wellness (FortiSoul), youth and family hands-on learning (Camp FortiSoul), and a Community Health Initiative focused on preventative care, blood pressure awareness, stress, and lifestyle in underserved Kansas City communities. JFLI works alongside the Black Archives of Mid-America and other local partners.
